abstract: A 35-year-old man complained of a painless enlargement of the right testis. Imaging diagnostic procedures demonstrated a multiloculated cystic tumor, 9 cm in maximal diameter, in the right testis with hydrocele. Orchidectomy specimen showed that the tumor was confined within the testis and separated from the epididymis. The locules of the tumor were lined by single-layered columnar epithelium, intermingled with MUC2 immunopositive goblet and chromogranin-A immunopositive neuroendocrine cells, exhibiting intestinal differentiation. No ciliated cell, teratomatous element or intratubular germ cell neoplasia were seen. Channels of rete testis were compressed peripherally by the tumor but there was no connection with the tumor locules. The tumor was diagnosed as mucinous cystadenoma of the testis. This seems to be the first published case of benign mucinous cystadenoma occurring within the testis. This intratesticular tumor with intestinal differentiation may represent a benign monodermal teratoma.
abstract_ja: 35歳の男性が右精巣の無痛性腫大を訴えた。画像診断で、右精巣内に最大径9cmの多房性嚢胞性腫瘍と水瘤を認めた。精巣摘除標本では、腫瘍は精巣内に限局し精巣上体とは分離していた。腫瘍の小腔は単層円柱上皮で覆われ、MUC2陽性の杯細胞とクロモグラニンA陽性の神経内分泌細胞が混在し、腸管分化を示していた。線毛細胞、奇形腫成分、精細管内胚細胞腫瘍は認められなかった。精巣網の管腔は腫瘍により辺縁で圧迫されていたが、腫瘍小腔との連続性はなかった。本腫瘍は精巣粘液性嚢胞腺腫と診断された。精巣内に発生した良性粘液性嚢胞腺腫の初報例と思われる。腸管分化を示すこの精巣内腫瘍は、良性単一胚葉性奇形腫である可能性がある。
